sources.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
Google’s next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences

cards.summary: Google announced today its Genie 4 world model for generating interactive experiences using AI. The company says the model has four main updates: It allows for more realistic worlds, lets users update an experience in real time with a natural language prompt, can generate audio, and uses Gemini 3.8 Flash under the hood to help with its simulations.
cards.title: Google’s next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences

sources.title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app

cards.summary: Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations. According to its Apple and Play Store listings, the "16-bit pet care game" is not really a game, but "a daily journal disguised as a pet." Users should talk, not type, with their pets, the description says, as well as play "cozy games" like stacking groceries or word games.
cards.title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app

sources.title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring

cards.summary: Mozilla is updating Smart Window - Firefox's AI-powered browsing experience - with a new feature that can help you fill out online forms based on your open tabs. As an example, Mozilla says Smart Window can pull information from your online portfolio or LinkedIn page to paste your work history into a job application.
cards.title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
